title: Nyang Merge Privacy Policy
description: How Nyang Merge handles on-device storage, Google Play Games, Android backup, ads and ad consent, problem reports, and data deletion.
version: Applies to version 1.0.0. We update this page and its date when features or ad setup change.
summary: You play without creating an account, and your game records are stored on your device. If you sign in to Google Play Games, your best score is stored on Google's leaderboard. TeamCP runs no server that receives your game records, and the game has no in-app purchases. The ad services (Unity LevelPlay and Unity Ads) process device information and advertising identifiers needed to deliver ads; on first launch we ask whether you consent to personalized ads and do not start the ad SDK until you choose. Report content is sent to TeamCP's report server only when you send a problem report yourself from Settings.

sections.title: 1. Scope and operator
paragraphs: TeamCP develops and operates the Android game “Nyang Merge” (냥이 합치기, com.teamcp.nyangmerge). This policy explains what information the game handles and the choices you have. Contact: teamcp.channel@gmail.com.

The game has no account sign-up of its own, no server that receives game records, no chat and no in-app purchases. Signing in is optional, and the only sign-in is Google Play Games. We do not request or collect your name, email, phone number, location (GPS), contacts, microphone, camera or storage. The permissions the app itself uses are internet and network state (ads, Play Games and problem reports), vibration (effects) and the advertising ID (AD_ID); the Android ad services attribution and topics APIs may be used by the ad SDK, and the WAKE_LOCK, RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED and FOREGROUND_SERVICE permissions are included by the ad SDK libraries. If you contact support by email, we use your address and message only to reply.

sections.title: 2. Information stored on your device
items: Game records: your best score, Churu (in-game currency), outfit, collection and daily-goal progress, and a record of rewarded-ad rewards so the same reward is not paid twice
Settings: music, sound and vibration, language, personalized-ads choice
Unsent problem reports: a report you sent is kept on the device (up to 50) until the server accepts it, and is then sent again
paragraphs: This information is kept in the app's private Android storage to keep your progress and settings. Game records and settings are never sent to TeamCP servers. There is no cloud save. The app contains no analytics (such as Firebase Analytics) or automatic crash-reporting tools. Problem reports are sent only when you send them yourself (section 7).

sections.title: 3. Google Play Games
paragraphs: When the app starts it tries to sign in automatically with the Google Play Games account set up on your device. Signing in is optional: if you are not signed in or sign-in fails, you can still play the whole game; only the leaderboard record is not kept.
While you are signed in, at game over your best score is submitted to the Google Play Games leaderboard and a ranking screen is shown. Google Play Games (Google LLC) then processes the following:
items: Your Play Games profile name (player name) and leaderboard best score — scores and profile names may be shown to other players on the ranking screen
after: The game does not separately receive or store your name, profile picture or email (Google Play Games services handle them). Your game progress is not uploaded to Google (no cloud save), and because the app has no servers, TeamCP does not store this information either and only sees aggregated leaderboard statistics in Play Console. Google's Privacy Policy and the Google Play Games Services terms apply to this processing.

sections.title: 4. Android Auto Backup
paragraphs: This app does not turn off Android Auto Backup, so backup and device-to-device transfer are allowed. If Google backup is turned on in your device settings, the game records and settings above (including problem reports still waiting on the device) may be included in your Google Account backup under Google's policies and restored when you reinstall the app or move to a new device.
This backup is a Google feature controlled by your device settings; TeamCP cannot access it. You can turn it off or delete it in Settings > Google > Backup.

sections.title: 5. Ads and the information ad services process
paragraphs: The game is free and supported by ads, served through Unity LevelPlay (mediation) and Unity Ads. It does not include AdMob, Google ad SDKs, Firebase or payment SDKs.

Ads are: a banner shown at the bottom of the game screen at all times once you have made your consent choice (hidden while a full-screen ad is showing); interstitials shown between rounds with frequency and interval limits; and a rewarded ad (“one more chance” at game over) that plays only when you choose it. You never have to watch a rewarded ad to keep playing.
To load and show ads, the ad services may process:
items: Advertising ID, app set ID and other ad/SDK identifiers
Device information such as model, OS, language, screen, network type and carrier
IP address and the approximate region derived from it
Ad interactions such as impressions and clicks, plus ad-related error and diagnostic data
Information about certain installed apps (for example, whether app stores such as Google Play are installed)
after: These are used to deliver and measure ads, prevent ad fraud, and — with your consent — personalize ads. The app is marked as “not directed to children” with the ad services. TeamCP does not receive individual user data from the ad services; we only see aggregated revenue and impression statistics in their dashboards.

sections.title: 6. Your ad choices
items: Every player is shown an allow/decline choice — “Do you consent to personalized ads?” — on first launch; the ad SDK does not start and no ads are shown until you choose. If you decline, you see the same number of ads but they are not personalized.
You can make the choice again anytime under Settings > “광고 동의 다시 보기” (review ad consent).
In Android Settings > Privacy > Ads you can reset or delete your advertising ID. Once deleted, a zeroed value is sent instead and cannot be used for personalized ads.
Use the privacy icon inside an ad or the Unity policy below to access, delete or opt out of ad data.
With the internet turned off no ad requests are made, and the game can still be played offline.
paragraphs: Your choice is stored only on your device and passed to the ad service (Unity LevelPlay) as a consent signal. If you decline, the ad SDK receives a refusal of consent (GDPR consent set to false) together with a “do not sell or share” signal under certain U.S. state laws.

sections.title: 7. Problem reports
paragraphs: A report is sent only when you write a message under Settings > “Report a problem · Contact”, agree to the information being sent, and tap Send. Nothing is reported automatically and there is no crash reporting. A report contains:
items: The message you wrote (up to 2,000 characters) and the type you chose (Problem or Question)
Attached automatically: app name and version, the name of the screen you reported from, app language, device model and Android version, and a random report number created for each report
Only if you turn on “Attach recent game log”: recent game events (screen changes, scores, ad loading results, error messages — up to 6,000 characters)
after: Reports do not include your advertising ID, any account, Google Play Games information or location. Please do not write personal information such as your name or contact details in the message. Reports are sent over an encrypted connection (HTTPS) and stored on the report server operated by TeamCP (web hosting: Cafe24, Republic of Korea), and are used only to investigate and fix problems or answer questions. The server and hosting provider may process your IP address as a connection log while the report is sent. Reports stored on the server are kept for 90 days from receipt and then deleted, or deleted right away if you ask before then.
If you are offline or sending fails, the report is kept on the device and sent again later. Reports waiting on the device are erased when you clear the app's data.

sections.title: 8. Third-party services and international processing
paragraphs: Unity LevelPlay and Unity Ads (Unity Technologies) and Google's Play Games, Android backup and ad services are governed by their own policies. Ad information, Play Games data and backup data may be processed outside your country; see each provider's policy for recipients, locations and safeguards. Problem reports are stored on a hosting server in the Republic of Korea.

TeamCP does not sell your information. However, some laws may treat data processing in the advertising ecosystem as a “sale” or “sharing”, so please also review the opt-out and rights information from the providers below.

sections.title: 9. Deleting data and retention
items: On the device: uninstall the app, or use Android Settings > Apps > 냥이 합치기 (Nyang Merge) > Storage > Clear data to erase all game data including settings and unsent reports. TeamCP keeps no game records on its servers.
Problem reports you sent: email teamcp.channel@gmail.com with the date you sent it and your device model (and part of the message if you can), and we will find and delete it.
Google Play Games: you can remove leaderboard scores and your Play Games profile by deleting the game data or profile, or signing out, in the Google Play Games app (or Play Store) settings.
Android backup: turn off or delete backups under Settings > Google > Backup.
Ad information: delete or reset your advertising ID and use the request process in Unity's policy. Uninstalling the app does not erase information ad providers have already processed.
Need help? Email teamcp.channel@gmail.com with the app name and your request. Never send passwords or ID documents. For data TeamCP does not hold, we will point you to the right provider's process.
paragraphs: Game data on your device remains until you delete it. Problem reports sent to the server are deleted 90 days after receipt. Retention of Play Games, backup and ad information follows each provider's policy. We keep support emails no longer than needed after replying.

sections.title: 10. Your rights
paragraphs: Depending on where you live, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, restrict or object to processing, withdraw consent, opt out of sale/sharing, or complain to a supervisory authority. Because TeamCP keeps no game data on its own servers, most requests are handled with device settings, Google Play Games or the ad providers' processes, while requests about problem reports are handled by TeamCP directly. We will tell you which route to use.

sections.title: 11. Children and parents
paragraphs: Nyang Merge is a puzzle game about dropping cats and merging cats of the same tier. It is an all-ages game, but because it contains ads it is not directed to children under 13. The app is marked “not directed to children” with the ad services and has no age check or parental-consent feature.
If you believe a child under 13 has had information processed, contact us and we will explain how to delete it.

sections.title: 12. Security and changes
paragraphs: Game data is kept in the app’s private Android storage, which other apps cannot read. Ad traffic, Play Games and backups use each provider’s encrypted connections, and problem reports are sent over an encrypted connection (HTTPS).

When features, SDKs or processing change, we update this policy and its date and announce important changes on this page. If the Korean and English versions of this policy seem to differ, please contact us.
